---
title: "Documentation"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/fetch-data.R")
vignettes <- get_vignettes()
packages <- unique(vignettes$package)
```

Vignettes and tutorials from ggseg packages. Each links to the full article on the package documentation site.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

for (pkg in packages) {
  pkg_vigs <- vignettes[vignettes$package == pkg, ]
  cat(sprintf('\n## %s {.section-header}\n\n', pkg))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pkg_vigs))) {
    vig <- pkg_vigs[i, ]
    cat(sprintf('- [%s](%s){target="_blank"}\n', vig$title, vig$url))
  }
  cat('\n')
}
```
